subject: NovaMed onboarding kickoff — proposed windows & prework
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@novamed.com>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: NovaMed onboarding kickoff — proposed windows & prework

Hi Elena / team,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and lots of alignment on product fit. Quick recap from our discovery:

- Primary use case: automate clinical coding suggestions in the intake workflow; expected throughput ~2k documents/day with median doc length ~600 tokens.
- Success criteria you called out: >85% precision on code suggestion top-1 for a 6-week pilot, error-rate monitoring, and no PHI leakage in logs.
- Constraints: must run in us-west region, SOC 2 evidence required for procurement, and need per-token cost targets for budget planning.

Next step we discussed: schedule a 60-minute evaluation kickoff (tech deep dive + pilot plan). To make scheduling fast, attached a short trial playbook and a few proposed windows (ICS). Please review and confirm which slot works for your team.

Proposed kickoff windows (PT):
- Option A: Tue, 2026-11-09 10:00–11:00 PT
- Option B: Wed, 2026-11-10 14:00–15:00 PT
- Option C: Thu, 2026-11-11 09:00–10:00 PT

Agenda I propose:
1) 10m — Quick intro and success criteria alignment (Elena + clinical lead)
2) 30m — Technical deep dive: data shapes, auth, VPC options (Ben to lead)
3) 15m — Trial plan and timelines (Kimberly to cover procurement / contract asks)
4) 5m — Action items & immediate blockers (deliverables and owners)

Prework requests (minimal):
- A short sample (2–5) of de-identified documents we can use for prompt tuning.
- Your success criteria written into the one-pager in the playbook (I've left placeholders).
- Pointing us at your procurement contact if different from the procurement alias on this thread.

Attachments: novamed_trial_playbook_v1.pdf (trial charter + success criteria template), proposed_kickoff_slots.ics (three slots).

If none of the options work, tell me two times that fit your calendar and we'll accommodate. Once we lock the slot Ben will prep a short technical checklist so we can make the kickoff pragmatic and hands-on.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking this off.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0119

From: Elena Soto <elena@novamed.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaMed onboarding kickoff — proposed windows & prework

Hi Marcus — thanks for the clear recap and the playbook.

We can do Option B: Wed, 2026-11-10 14:00–15:00 PT. I'll be joined by Samir Patel (clinical lead) and Maya Desai (PM). Procurement will loop in our contracts lead — I've cc'd the procurement alias.

Quick Qs:
- We need to confirm whether the evaluation will be run in a dedicated VPC or hosted mode for the pilot. Can you confirm what information Ben needs from us ahead of the kickoff?
- Procurement asked for an initial SOC 2 summary and a copy of your data retention policy. Are those included in the playbook or separate?

I'll upload a sanitized sample doc to the shared Drive link you sent by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Elena
Director of Product, NovaMed Health
elena@novamed.com

Perfect — thanks Elena. Wed, 2026-11-10 14:00–15:00 PT is locked on my calendar. I'll send a calendar invite with the agenda and a short intake form for participants (link below).

Ben — can you lead the technical deep dive and prepare a 1-page checklist of the items we'll want to validate in the kickoff (auth, sample data ingestion, metrics collection)?
Kimberly — I'll put procurement action items in the invite and flag the SOC 2 / data retention docs for procurement.

Intake form for attendees: https://forms.redwood.ai/novamed-intake-2026
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DEAL-2026-1097
Drive: https://drive.google.com/novamed/trial-playbook (I uploaded the playbook there)

Elena — for your Qs:
- We'll run the evaluation in Dedicated mode by default for production parity; if you prefer hosted for speed we can discuss trade-offs during the kickoff. Ben, please note: confirm what network information we need for Dedicated (VPC subnet ranges, firewall egress rules).
- SOC 2 summary + data retention FAQ are in the "Compliance" tab of the playbook (see Drive link). If procurement wants an exported PDF we can attach it to the DocuSign packet.

Action items before kickoff:
- Elena: upload a sanitized sample (2–5 docs) to the Drive and fill the intake form (key fields: data types, expected throughput, clinical code taxonomy).
- Procurement: confirm contract owner and initial PO timeline.
- Ben: draft the technical checklist and share as a short doc by Nov 5.
- Marcus/Kimberly: prepare the SOW outline and pilot pricing band for discussion at kickoff.

I'll send the invite shortly.

—Marcus

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Novamed Procurement <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NovaMed onboarding kickoff — proposed windows & prework

Thanks Marcus — slot confirmed on my end. Quick tech notes ahead of the kickoff:

Pre-kickoff checklist (I'll publish a 1-pager by Nov 5):
- Auth: API key vs. short-lived token for Dedicated; we'll need an admin user and an ssh-friendly contact if we do private appliance modes.
- Data ingestion: S3 or secure upload to our intake endpoint; please include file types and typical sizes.
- Metrics: define the event types you'd like instrumented (e.g., suggestion_accepted, suggestion_rejected, latency_p50/p95).
- Prompt set: please share 10 canonical prompts / examples you want the pilot to prioritize (redact PHI).
- Access: will you want shared read-only access to pilot logs for internal audit?

Compliance attachments: forwarding the summary excerpt from our SOC 2 package for procurement to review (see attached stub). If procurement needs the full report we'll coordinate an NDA / secure transfer.

Forwarded-attachment-stub: redwood_soc2_summary_2026.pdf (PDF)

If you can push the sample prompts and one de-identified document into the Drive by Nov 4, I'll use them to prepare a small prompt/eval pack we can run during the kickoff to show immediate signal.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
